name: furima-mcp
description: Search Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, Yahoo! Flea Market and Rakuma, and check prices against what items actually sold for.
long_description: Searches Japan's four big second-hand marketplaces at once. Get median and quartiles of recent sold prices, split by item condition; judge whether a price is fair; and watch a search for new listings. Read-only: no account, cookie or API key, and requests to each site are spaced out.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search items for sale now across the four sites.

tools.description: Listings put up since the last check.

tools.name: sold_price_stats
